$comment: Issue #43. Names given to a child whose parent left the name blank. Short, gentle, easy to read aloud; letters only (CHILD_NAME_PATTERN). None is an everyday English word: the quality gate finds a child's name case-insensitively, so a name like 'Wren' or 'Hazel' would let 'a little wren' or 'hazel trees' stand in for the child (code review, PR #45). No franchise characters, and none of the fixture children (Milo, Juno, Theo). test/unit/child-names.test.ts checks every entry against the schema, L1 and, where the system has one, the word list.
